column11: ICER, Acute Treatments for Migraine, Final Evidence Report (Institute for Clinical and Economic Review, 2020), Table 6.1: an annual WAC of 4,896 USD a year, applied to rimegepant as a placeholder because its WAC had not been released when the report was written. Pfizer's own current disclosure is 1,028.99 USD per blister pack of eight 75 mg orally disintegrating tablets (Connecticut HB 6669, data as of 13-Jan-2025), that is 128.62 USD a dose, so ICER's 4,896 USD corresponds to about 38 doses a year. The FDA label sets no schedule, only a ceiling: 75 mg as needed, at most one dose in 24 hours, and the safety of more than 18 doses in 30 days has not been established. 18 doses a month at today's unit price would be 27,783 USD a year
